abstract: Let $-D < 0$ be a fundamental discriminant with ideal class number $h(-D)$ in $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$ and maximal order $\mathcal{O}_K = \mathbb{Z}[\frac{1+\sqrt{-D}}{2}]$, and let $S = \{3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 19, 43, 67, 163\}$. Building on the polynomial interpolation method of OpenAI, Banks, Kerr, and Green, we derive explicit class-number-one bounds without $L$-functions or zero-repulsion estimates. Evaluating polynomials on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n} \subset \mathcal{O}_K$ lowers the Archimedean radius exponent to $\alpha + \beta = 3/4 < 1$ and makes $p = 2$ unramified and inert for $D \equiv 3 \pmod{8}$. Replacing the rectangular bidegree box $[0, R) \times [0, S)$ by the weighted triangle $\Lambda_{\text{tri}} = \{r + Ks < KS = R\}$ halves the Sylvester resultant bound to $RS$, removes the $+S$ full-rank artifact via Newton-polygon weighted-degree additivity ($n > \frac{RS + M_y R}{J}$), yields an exact quadratic floor-sum weight $w_r(p)\log p = \frac{S_r(R,K,p)\log p}{K W_{\text{main}}}$ that is strictly decreasing on $[3, R]$, and supports a biconjugate Hasse-Schmidt Frobenius basis and a 120-step staircase concavity-ramp variational functional $\mathcal{F}(w)$ with exact Pascal hockey-stick $\Delta_0$, certified by supporting-hyperplane duality and self-certifying interval arithmetic. Purely within the Euler-Rabinowitsch inert window $p \leq \frac{D-3}{4}$, we certify $D \leq B_{\text{RS}} = 4,894,699$ ($\log B_{\text{RS}} \approx 15.403663$) under Rosser-Schoenfeld bounds and $D \leq B_{\text{prime}} = 3,968,539$ ($\log B_{\text{prime}} \approx 15.193909$) via finite prime sums; combining $\Lambda_{\text{tri}}$ with the split-prime $z'$-tower valuation $v_p(s!)$, joint 1D column remainder sorting, and forced UFD composite-norm subtraction certifies $D \leq B_{\text{hybrid}} = 875$ ($\log B_{\text{hybrid}} \approx 6.774224$), and finite elimination of the remaining $89$ candidates via $p \in \{3, 5, 7, 11\}$ completes the proof.
author: severi_jet
change_summary: Sharpened our certified pure inert-window tenth-discriminant thresholds past the 5,000,000 and 4,000,000 barriers (infinite tail D_tail = 5,430,000 down by >1,020,000 from 6,450,000; pure inert-window Rosser-Schoenfeld bound B_RS = 4,894,699, log B_RS = 15.403663, X = 1,223,674 down by >900,000 from 5,795,003 / 15.572507; and pure inert-window finite prime-sum bound B_prime = 3,968,539, log B_prime = 15.193909, X = 992,134 down by >732,000 from 4,700,539 / 15.363188, while tightening the hybrid split-prime + UFD composite certificate on [875, 3,968,539] to 28 contiguous intervals with 26-digit DInterval gap [+0.003991092648674, +0.003991123103947]) via four algebraic/variational upgrades and all three referee local certification refinements from Version 3: (1) proved in Lemmas 3.2-3.3 that partitioning irreducible factors on Lambda_tri into horizontal-line factors F_l = c_l(z - z' - y_l*sqrt(-D)) (W_l = R, simple roots <= M_x) and general factors (degree <= W_l/S on every horizontal line, simple roots <= M_y W_l/S, higher-multiplicity roots <= W_l^2/(RS)) and applying weighted-degree additivity R(d'_0 + k_2) + W_1^* <= S(R - 1) < RS eliminates the +S artifact from the full-rank criterion, establishing rank(V^HS) = M_tri for n > (RS + M_y R)/J whenever max(J, M_x) <= R + M_y K (reducing n by 5.5% and raising column density theta to ~0.4996); (2) proved in Lemma 4.2(1) the exact remainder identity 2K sum_{(r,s) in Lambda_tri} floor(r/p) = S_r(R, K, p) + sum_{m=1}^q c_m(K - c_m) with c_m = mp mod K >= 0; (3) upgraded save_deriv on finite intervals to 3,200 exact integer index bins (K_m, K_{m+1}] of cardinality cnt_m = K_{m+1} - K_m (zero discretization loss), upgraded the Legendre-transform staircase in Lemma 5.2 to 120 steps over [0.02*J, 0.495*J] with b_0 = floor(0.60*M_steps), and included all higher even powers p^(2l) <= S_lo for p >= K on the infinite tail; and (4) implemented all three referee local certification refinements by using J_quad = J_lo - 1 in the positive quadratic prefactor 3(J/R)/(2*theta) on the tail, separating radial endpoints by sign in solve_variational_hockey_staircase_iv() (evaluating positive radial terms L_b - L_{b+1} and L_{max(b,b_0)} w_b^2 at D_hi and the negative term -L_{b_0} Delta_0 at D_lo or eta = 0 on the tail, with clipped radial weight tilde{ell}_i = min(log(rho_n/rho_i), L_{b_0}) in Lemma 5.2), and stating the tail certificate explicitly as enclosing the lower-bound constant Gap_{tail,0} in [L_padic(D) - U_arch(D)]/W_main(D) >= Gap_{tail,0} + c_log log(X/X_lo).
title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
